recipes.title: Grinch Spaghetti
recipes.from: Mommy Needs A Recipe!! on Facebook
recipes.note: Green noodles for the Christmas season — ours came out just as bright as the picture.

photos.alt: A plate of green Grinch spaghetti with meat sauce
Green noodles and meat sauce cooking on the stove

ingredients: Optional: garlic powder or Italian seasoning
steps: Fill a large pot with water. Add about ½ teaspoon green food coloring and stir well.
Bring the water to a rolling boil and add the spaghetti noodles.
Cook according to the package, usually 9–11 minutes, stirring once or twice so they don't stick.
Drain the noodles completely and set aside.
Brown the ground beef, drain, and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder or Italian seasoning.
Stir in the spaghetti sauce and heat through.
Serve the sauce over the green noodles and top with a red candy heart.
